name: Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc.
old_description: Kulicke and Soffa is a global leader in semiconductor assembly technology, advancing device performance across automotive, compute, industrial, memory and communications markets. Founded on innovation in 1951, K&S is uniquely positioned to overcome increasingly dynamic process challenges - creating and delivering long-term value by aligning technology with opportunity.
about:
Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc. was founded in 1951 in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. The company began as an innovator in semiconductor assembly technology and has grown into a global provider of equipment and solutions for the semiconductor industry.

The company designs and manufactures semiconductor assembly equipment, including thermocompression bonding systems, ultrasonic assembly tools such as the ASTERION™‑TW for power applications, advanced dispensing solutions, and co-packaged optics (CPO) platforms for AI infrastructure. It also supplies aftermarket products, repair and refurbishment services, spare parts, and global components support.

K&S serves customers across automotive, compute, industrial, memory, and communications markets, as well as the emerging AI infrastructure sector. Its equipment is used by semiconductor manufacturers and assembly houses that require advanced packaging and interconnect solutions.

The company emphasizes breakthrough technologies such as fluxless thermocompression bonding, recognized with a SEMI Award for North America, and positions its portfolio to address dynamic process challenges in advanced packaging. Its stated mission is to align technology with opportunity to deliver long-term value.
